schema-version = "1.13.0"
# Generated by /floxify

[install]
# Elixir bundles Erlang/OTP — do not install erlang separately.
# .tool-versions pins elixir 1.20.2-otp-28; the catalog tops out at 1.19.5.
# mix.exs declares `elixir: "~> 1.18"`, which 1.19.5 satisfies.
elixir.pkg-path = "elixir_1_19"

# .tool-versions pins nodejs 23.2.0; the Dockerfile builder uses 23.11.1.
# Node 23 is an EOL line, so it shares no catalog page with a current Elixir —
# its own pkg-group lets both resolve independently.
nodejs.pkg-path = "nodejs_23"
nodejs.pkg-group = "nodejs"

# NIF compilation for bcrypt_elixir, siphash, lazy_html, happy_tcp
# (Dockerfile builder stage: gcc, libc-dev, make).
gcc.pkg-path = "gcc"
gnumake.pkg-path = "gnumake"

# mix.exs resolves ~15 dependencies straight from git.
git.pkg-path = "git"

# node-gyp (Dockerfile builder) and pre-commit (CONTRIBUTING.md).
python3.pkg-path = "python3"
pre-commit.pkg-path = "pre-commit"

# phoenix_bakery compresses release assets during `mix release`.
brotli.pkg-path = "brotli"

[vars]
# Match the `make postgres` / `make clickhouse` container defaults.
DATABASE_URL = "postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/plausible_dev"
CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE_URL = "http://localhost:8123/plausible_events_db"

[hook]
on-activate = """
  export MIX_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/mix"
  export HEX_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/hex"
  mkdir -p "$MIX_HOME" "$HEX_HOME"

  mix local.hex --force --if-missing >&2
  mix local.rebar --force --if-missing >&2
  mix deps.get >&2

  # assets/ and tracker/ are separate npm roots, installed by prefix.
  for d in assets tracker; do
    if [ ! -d "$d/node_modules" ] || [ "$d/package-lock.json" -nt "$d/node_modules" ]; then
      npm install --prefix "./$d" --silent >&2
    fi
  done

  # ecto.create/migrate are deliberately not run here — they need the
  # Postgres and ClickHouse containers up (`make postgres`, `make clickhouse`).
"""

[profile]
bash = 'export MIX_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/mix"; export HEX_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/hex"; export PATH="$MIX_HOME/escripts:$PATH"'
zsh = 'export MIX_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/mix"; export HEX_HOME="$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/hex"; export PATH="$MIX_HOME/escripts:$PATH"'
fish = 'set -x MIX_HOME "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/mix"; set -x HEX_HOME "$FLOX_ENV_CACHE/hex"; fish_add_path "$MIX_HOME/escripts"'

[options]
systems = ["aarch64-darwin", "aarch64-linux", "x86_64-darwin", "x86_64-linux"]
